changes.reason: Shell-first SSR reports the measurable interval to React shell readiness and delivers deferred region settlement time through the server-side callback.

kubernetes.reason: The Node fetch adapter serves the measured shell header over HTTP while the deferred region is held open.
constraints: The test executes the Node host locally. It does not establish live Kubernetes deployment or proxy behavior.
The header measures shell readiness rather than delivery through an ingress.

evidence.testName: real HTTP shell-first stream flushes the shell over a socket before the deferred region resolves

aws-lambda.reason: The local API Gateway adapter test samples the same shell milestone and returns it with the buffered HTML response.
constraints: The API Gateway v2 adapter buffers the full body. The shell duration excludes that buffering and API Gateway delivery.
The fixture simulates the invocation locally without an AWS runtime or deployment.

cloudflare.reason: Controlled clocks exercise Workers delivery policy in the local renderer tests. A deployed Workers isolate was not exercised.
constraints: The deployed Workers clock advances on I/O and cannot measure CPU-only execution. The duration is omitted when the clock does not advance.
